entities.summary: Kieron Robert Nnamdi Achara MBE is a Scottish professional basketball player who last played for the Glasgow Rocks. He is a 6-foot-10-inch (2.08 m) forward who played college basketball at Duquesne University and represented Scotland and Great Britain at national team level.
